parsed.mechanism: The replacement block ends with a trailing `"""` that is part of the Python source being patched. This trailing triple-quote is inserted into the function source and leaves the function's `if not has_images:` block open with an unmatched `"""` token, causing a SyntaxError when the patched function is loaded.
parsed.trigger: Any invocation of `_generate_and_score_completions` after applying the patch (which happens in `grpo_trainer` initialization).
parsed.consequence: The patched function is invalid Python and fails to compile, breaking GRPO training entirely.
